description: Full financial conditions read, the detail behind the Money and Financial conditions cards of get_dashboard (and the regime's Money row): global liquidity (Fed + ECB + BoJ central-bank balance sheets, FX-converted to USD; PBoC included when a fresh Mako-curated publication is available — basis 'g4' vs 'g3'), the 10-year real yield with its nominal and breakeven legs, HY/IG credit spreads, the dollar index (DXY), VIX. Inside global liquidity: us_net_liquidity (Fed balance sheet minus the Treasury General Account minus overnight reverse repo, with 4- and 12-week changes, its own classification and dated inputs; a supporting read, not part of the regime light) and change_decomposition (for the 4- and 12-week windows, how much of the change in dollars came from the balance sheets themselves and how much from exchange rates, which dominated, and the method). Returns composite + direction + per-pillar classifications + drivers. The `scope` and `scope_note` fields tell you whether the read is G4 or G3, and the China sub-component carries Mako-curated provenance (as_of_month, source_url, note). Pass summary_only:true for the lightweight one-line read used in regime composition.

summary_only.description: If true, return composite + direction + one-line driver only
